Each section tests a single inline shortcode parameter in isolation. No YAML calendar configuration is used.

## Detail items (scalar)

Confirm that location appears inside each event, then click one and confirm that
location is the only optional popup row.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" useDetailPopup="true" eventDetailItems="location" popupDetailItems="location" >}}

## Detail items (JSON arrays)

Confirm that location and calendar appear inside events, then click one and
confirm that only calendar appears in the popup.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" useDetailPopup="true" eventDetailItems='["location","calendar"]' popupDetailItems='["calendar"]' calendars='[{"id":"cal1","name":"Personal","backgroundColor":"#03bd9e"},{"id":"cal2","name":"Work","backgroundColor":"#00a9ff"}]' >}}

## `timeFormat` (default 24-hour)

Without a `timeFormat` parameter, confirm that timed events and the time-grid
axis use 24-hour time. Click an event and confirm that its detail popup also uses
24-hour time without AM/PM.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" useDetailPopup="true" >}}

## `timeFormat` (12-hour)

Confirm that timed events and the time-grid axis use 12-hour time with AM/PM.
Click an event and confirm that its detail popup uses the same format.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" useDetailPopup="true" timeFormat="12h" >}}

## `timeFormat` (invalid)

An unsupported value should render a styled error block listing the accepted values.

{{< toastui timeFormat="invalid" >}}

## `autoHourRange` (true)

Events run 09:30-10:15 and 14:00-15:00. The data also includes an all-day
event, which `autoHourRange` ignores when scanning for the timed extent.
Confirm the week time grid fits to exactly 09:30-15:00 instead of the full
day.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" autoHourRange="true" >}}

## `autoHourRange` (false)

Same data with `autoHourRange="false"`. Confirm the time grid shows the full
default day (00:00-24:00).

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" autoHourRange="false" >}}

## `timezone` (inline JSON object, naive timestamps)

The CSV events use naive timestamps (no UTC offset). Confirm they render at
their stated wall-clock time (09:30 and 14:00), resolved against
`Europe/Stockholm` even though this nested object is supplied as an inline
kwarg rather than YAML metadata.

{{< toastui file="data/events.csv" file-sep="," defaultView="week" date="2026-04-17" timezone='{"zones":[{"timezoneName":"Europe/Stockholm"}]}' >}}
